# Theory: Progressive Delivery is Reducing Blast Radius Over Time

Kubernetes RollingUpdate is maxUnavailable/maxSurge, not traffic-aware. Canary and blue-green split *traffic* or *replicas* and add pause/analysis gates.

## Invariants

1. A Rollout replaces a Deployment as the object that owns ReplicaSets.
2. Canary: some users (or pods) see the new version first.
3. Blue-green: two full stacks; cut traffic when ready.

```text
RollingUpdate   gradual pods, mixed traffic
Canary          gated traffic/replicas
Blue-green      two stacks, one cutover
```

## What can break

- Calling a 50% RollingUpdate a canary (no analysis, no traffic split).

## How to read this chapter

Beyond RollingUpdate, canary/blue-green, risk.
